items.title: Run autonomous agents on Kubernetes
items.oneliner: Open runtime for managing autonomous AI agent fleets with Kubernetes-native deployment, isolation, and security controls.

items.title: Train your pitch in real time
items.oneliner: Mac app that learns a song's melody and shows exactly where your singing goes off-key.

items.title: Expose only valid share links
items.oneliner: Caddy forward-auth setup that publishes private app share links without exposing the full service or requiring VPN access.

items.title: Unify folding across Emacs modes
items.oneliner: Kirigami gives Emacs one folding interface across Tree-sitter, Org, XML, and hide-show with consistent keybindings.

items.title: Speed up Org to HTML parsing
items.oneliner: OrgWebAlchemy cuts Org parsing from 32.2 ms to 5.1 ms and memory from 30.3 MB to 3.9 MB.

items.title: Package Python scripts with Nix
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide for shipping Python scripts with reproducible dependencies, rollbacks, and cross-distro execution using Nix flakes.

items.title: Scan and name network devices
items.oneliner: Practical arp-scan walkthrough for finding active IPv4 devices fast and building saner naming across home or lab networks.

items.title: Benchmark pure FP against C
items.oneliner: Compression benchmarks show Roc within 10% of libdeflate and Lean 4 beating Rust's miniz_oxide.

items.title: Learn from a benchmark disqualification
items.oneliner: ClickBench pull request details how cached results and per-query kernels invalidated a database benchmark entry.

items.title: Study a garbage collector in Rust
items.oneliner: Deep implementation writeup and public code for a Rust garbage collector that handles cyclic shared ownership.
